notes: TL;DR: mid-market SaaS (productivity) — liked Hosted API during trial; now evaluating Dedicated for stable unit economics and data isolation.
Trial summary: 3 weeks, ~10k MAU on feature flag, avg daily active users ~4k during business hours.
Token metrics from trial (hosted): median request tokens: 120 (prompt), median completion tokens: 340; 60% of chat exchanges <128 tokens completion; 15% >512 tokens.
Usage mix observed: chat ~70% of requests, embeddings ~8% (batched at client), async reranking ~12%, ad-hoc summarization ~10%.
Peak observed: 38 QPS sustained for 3-minute spikes; typical daytime avg QPS 9-12. Concurrency observed during product demo peaks: 60 sessions. Business wants capacity headroom x3.
Product asks for Dedicated sizing: target p95 generation latency <200ms for short prompts (<128 tokens), support for 250 concurrent chat sessions at 95% util with predictable tail latencies.

High-level forecast: plan to ramp from trial cohort to full release over 6 months — conservative estimate: 3x current tokens/day (from ~0.8M tokens/day to ~2.4M); embed jobs expected to double once search feature GA.
Cost sensitivity: procurement target unit cost equivalent to <$0.0009 per output token under typical mix; willing to pay commitment for predictable pricing.
Security: must support SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS for encryption, audit logs retention 1 year, ability to pin model versions; prefer VPC/private endpoint for Dedicated.
Routing/fallback: require automatic fallback to smaller model variant for non-critical traffic and region-aware routing (EU residency for some customers).
Quote from CTO on 2026-02-20 call: "We loved the latency profile on hosted; main ask is to remove cold-start variability and get steady per-token cost for GA."
SE notes (Carlos): suggested three Dedicated configs: Small (cost-efficient, optimized batching), Medium (balanced latency/cost), Large (high-concurrency, lower-latency, KV cache reserved).
POC milestones asked by client: 1) Capacity proposal + cost model, 2) Security & KMS readiness sign-off, 3) 2-week smoke test on Dedicated with production traffic mirror.
Open questions: exact tokenization for some proprietary prompt templates (affects token budget), SLA language for p95 latency, EU data residency enforcement path.
Internal: create cost model spreadsheet variant for their token mix (linked), prepare quote with 12- and 36-month commitment options, include optimize recommendations for batching and cache TTLs.
